Comparative Runtime Architecture · Kernel & WASM Isolation Boundaries · Memory Footprint · Attack Surface Analysis

g.text: • Single Node process shares all memory
Strictly isolate on VPS; avoid main workstation.
• Local LLM: vLLM & Ollama native support
• Tools still share host process memory
Ideal for developers auditing all agent code.
• Isolation: Linux container per chat group
• Group A CANNOT access Group B data
• Cannot bypass boundary via API calls
High security agent on macOS & Linux.
Production-tested by Qwibit AI sales operations.
• Isolation: WASM Capability grants per tool
• Secrets injected at host execution boundary
• Tool code NEVER sees raw API keys/tokens
